messages:
Amir - People Ops: Quick flow for manager -> IC handoffs for self-reviews. Wanted to share a compact checklist we tested last cycle.

Amir - People Ops: Goal of this thread: make manager prep + IC prompt <2 minutes to paste/send.

Amir - People Ops: Micro-checklist (pasteable):
```
[Manager Prep - 2 min]
- Confirm 3 primary goals and owner per goal.
- Pick 1 metric/signal per goal (how we'll measure).
- Note one coaching point for growth.
- Schedule a 20-min review 3 days before deadline.

[IC Prompt - copy to message]
- Top 3 wins (bullets).
- For each active goal: 1 metric/signal + 1 example.
- One growth area + suggested support.
- Any blockers or resourcing asks.
```

Jules - Eng Manager: This is gold. Can we add a one-liner rubric managers can use for quick calibration?

Amir - People Ops: Yep 1-line rubric suggestion: "Impact (0-5), Reliability (0-5), Craft/Ownership (0-5)". Put totals next to names for quick sort.

Priya - Design Lead: Small UX note: ask ICs to paste links to three artifacts (PRs, Figma files, notes). Makes calibration easier.

Amir - People Ops: Good call. Add: "Please include up to 3 links to artifacts or PRs."

Marco - IC: Can you share a short manager message I can expect? I like concrete examples.

Amir - People Ops: Manager DM template (short):
```
Hey {{name}}, self-reviews open Apr 1-14. Please reply here with:
- 3 wins (bulleted)
- Per goal: metric + 1 concrete example
- 1 growth area + ask
- Up to 3 artifact links
I'll send a 20-min sync if you want help writing it.
```

Jules - Eng Manager: Also adding a "late note" clause: if someone misses window, they have 48hrs to submit without manager followup. Keeps process moving.

Amir - People Ops: Noted. I'll add that to the one-pager. Also scheduling a 30-min office hours drop-in the second week for anyone who wants help.

hr-bot: Reminder: self-review window opens 2026-04-01 and closes 2026-04-14. Office hours: 2026-04-09 10:00-10:30 PT.

Priya - Design Lead: Thanks! I'll paste the templates into my team channel and ping folks 7 days before deadline.

Marco - IC: Appreciated 1 I'll use the manager DM to kick mine off.

Amir - People Ops: Thanks team. If you want a split variant (IC shorter vs. Lead longer), reply and Ill draft two sizes.
